subTitle: Common questions about KUNDA products, free utilities, and our digital ecosystem.

faqs.question: What is KUNDA?
faqs.answer: KUNDA is an independent digital ecosystem and parent brand uniting targeted micro-SaaS applications, free developer utilities, curated resources, and technical guides under one central digital roof.

faqs.question: Are the online tools really 100% free?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our JSON Formatter, Password Analyzer, and QR Code Generator require no account creation, no subscription, and run client-side in your browser with strict data privacy.

faqs.question: What is Micro-SaaS and how does it work at KUNDA?
faqs.answer: Les produits Micro-SaaS sont des applications logicielles légères et ciblées conçues pour résoudre un problème opérationnel spécifique sans la complexité des suites d'entreprise.

faqs.question: How can I access downloadable resources?
faqs.answer: Visit our Resources directory to browse developer checklists and client onboarding templates. Free resources are unlocked directly for community download.

faqs.question: How do I request a custom digital tool or integration?
faqs.answer: Reach out through our Contact page or email hello@kunda.works to discuss custom software development, tool partnerships, or digital consulting.
